To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the holding voltage of nLDMO with a “npn” arrangement and a discrete distribution of parasitic SCR is greatly enhanced with the decreasing parasitic SCR OD.
the ESD and LU robustness levels can be improved by modulating the parasitic SCR of the nLMOs with discrete distribution in the STI structure of the drain side.
the nLDMO device embedded with a parasitic-SCR “pnp” type & OD discrete structure in the drain side can achieve the best ESD and LU performances.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ESD reliability improvement of a 0.25µm nLDMOS power device.
the layout optimization and design of nLDMO devices with a discrete embedded SCR in the drain-side.
a systematic layout design to improve the ESD and LU robustness levels of a power nLDMO device.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the nLDMO device with a parasitic “npn” arranged SCR in the drain-side and the parasitic SCR with a thin oxide (i.e. OD discrete parameter 3)
the “pnp“-arranged type and the OD discrete parameter-2 (DIS- 2) of the parasitic SCR can yield the highest ESD and LU robustness levels.
the nLDMOs with a drain-side parasitic “pnp” SCR OD discrete distribution is the most suitable layout design for the ESD robustness of nLDMOs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the “pnp"-arranged type & DIS-2 is the most suitable layout for an HV nL DMOS with a parasitc SCR in the drain side. Proc. SPIE 10585,
the “pnp"-arranged type & discrete distribution of the drain-side parasitic SCR in nLDMOS is a good choice to improve the ESD and LU robustness of nLDMOs.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the nLDMOs with “pnp” type & OD discrete layout can be applied in the high voltage IC design to improve the ESD reliability.
the layout optimization of the nLMOs embedded with a drain side “pnp” arrangement type and discrete distribution of parasitic SCR can improve the ESD robustness.
the nLDMO device with the drain-side discrete SCR “pnp"-arranged type & low-OD can achieve a higher ESD robustness and lower LU risk.
